sentences.text:
Neutral Citation No. - 2023:Ahc-Lko:54830
Court No. - 16
Case :- Criminal Misc. Bail Application No. - 10336 of 2023

Applicant :- Jai Prakash Prajapati
Opposite Party :- State Of U.P. Thru. Prin. Secy. Home Lko.

Counsel for Applicant :- Sunil Kumar Singh,Sudhir Kumar
Counsel for Opposite Party :- G.A.
Hon'ble Subhash Vidyarthi,J.
1.

Heard Sri Sudhir Kumar, learned counsel for the applicant, Sri Gyanendra Singh, learned A.G.A.
for the State and Sri Shiv Poojan Verma, Advocate who has put in appearance on behalf of the
informant and filed his vakalatnama, which is taken on record.

2. The instant application has been filed seeking release of the applicant on bail in Case Crime No.41
of 2022, under Sections 409, 420 I.P.C., registered at Police Station Gomti Nagar, District Lucknow.

3.  The aforesaid case has been registered on the basis of an F.I.R. lodged on 13.01.2022 against six persons, including the applicant who is described in the F.I.R. as Senior Team Leader of the Company, alleging that the informant had made some investment in Massire Infrateck Private limited but upon maturity no amount was paid to the informant.
4.
In the affidavit filed in support of bail application it has been stated that the applicant is innocent and he has been falsely implicated in the present case.
A supplementary affidavit has been filed disclosing the applicant's involvement in 51 cases of similar nature, in 37 of which the applicant has already been granted bail.

It has also been stated that the co-accused persons Ratan Chand Dwivedi and Jainuddin Ansari, who are the Managing Director and Director of the company respectively,
Jai Prakash Prajapati vs State Of U.P. Thru. Prin. Secy. Home Lko.

entities.text: Jai Prakash Prajapati vs State Of U.P. Thru. Prin. Secy. Home Lko
entities.label: PRECEDENT

sentences.text:
on 18 August, 2023 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/92083874/
1 have already been enlarged on bail by this court and copies of their bail orders have been annexed with the supplementary affidavit.
5. The learned A.G.A. has opposed the prayer for bail but he could not dispute the aforesaid aspects of the matter.

6. Having considered the aforesaid facts and circumstances of the case and keeping in view the fact that the grievance of the informant is regarding non-payment of the amount invested in a company and the applicant does not hold any principal place in the company; that the Managing Director and Director of the company have already been enlarged on bail and the applicant is languishing in jail since 25.07.2021 and without making any observation, which may affect the merits of the case, I am of the view that the aforesaid facts are sufficient for making out a case for enlargement of the applicant on bail in the aforesaid crime.
7. Accordingly, this bail application stands allowed.
